name: 2221-sharegpt-70b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, all eight GPUs of one node.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1; one vLLM engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 20%, no cooldown, bounded at 2000 requests with a 2400 s safety cap; streams equals `max-num-seqs` and the two move together.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-2000-llama2.jsonl`: 2000 single-turn ShareGPT_V3 conversations, 479893 prompt + 487783 output tokens, replies generated to their recorded length with `ignore_eos`.
purpose: A 70-billion-parameter general-purpose assistant answering 256 concurrent one-shot user questions with long replies across one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# The engine's launch arguments. This file is read FLAT: `key: value` lines only, and an
# indented block silently never reaches AsyncEngineArgs, so keep every value on one line.
#
# This engine is a January-2024 source checkout and its AsyncEngineArgs is small: an unknown key
# is a TypeError at construction. Do not add flags from a later vLLM.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-70b-hf
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own window (max_position_embeddings 4096); the engine raises above it.
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096

# The scheduler's cap on the resident batch. Equal to `scenario.json`'s 256 streams by
# construction: the two move together and never independently.
max-num-seqs: 256

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
dtype: float16

# The repo carries the same 70B twice: 15 *.safetensors and 29 *.bin. `auto` globs BOTH into
# snapshot_download and then reads only the safetensors, so `auto` pays a 138 GB download it
# never opens. Pinning the format selects the same files `auto` would have loaded.
load-format: safetensors
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
max-paddings: 256

# CUDA graph capture cannot complete at TP=8 on this toolchain. Capturing this engine's
# torch.distributed all-reduce makes NCCL 2.20.5 allocate inside the capture region, which is
# illegal, so every rank dies with `Failed to CUDA malloc 8192 bytes` ->
# `operation not permitted when stream is capturing`, and the engine then hangs rather than
# exiting. Pinned on so the run reaches the benchmark; see configs/note.md.
enforce-eager: true
